correctness.rationale: Correctness PASS for ordinary unordered two-point configuration space of the Heawood graph. Rebuilt both the [5,−5]^7 graph and the Fano-plane incidence model (14 vertices,21 edges,girth6); the cubical model has (91,252,168) cells and ∂1∂2=0. Exact ∂2 Smith invariant factors are 153 ones plus a 2 (rank154); ∂1 rank90 gives H1=Z^8⊕Z/2 and H2=Z^14. Complete enumeration recovers 28 simple hexagons, 42 disjoint pairs; their product 2-chains are closed. The explicit 14×14 minor has determinant −1, proving an integral basis for the saturated rank14 kernel. Independently enumerated 336 graph automorphisms; all 42 geometric tori form one orbit. Cell-sign Lefschetz calculation plus graph first-homology rank8 gives the complete eight-class character table with zero average invariant dimension. Source direct action on integral torus basis was inspected; independently reconstructed character uses Lefschetz, not all source matrix actions.
residual_risks: The character is rational; no integral module indecomposable structure is asserted.
Exact finite enumeration does not establish an all-graph classification.

originality.rationale: Originality PASS, qualified and strictly excludes prior graph combinatorics. Lawrence–Wilson already proved the 28-hexagon census, 42 disjoint pairs and their automorphism transitivity. Previously published Heawood ordered two-point mod2 and unordered three-point configuration results concern different configurations/coefficient systems. The novel remainder is the unimodular basis inside H2 of the unordered two-point space, the integral H1 torsion and the full signed 336-element rational H2 character, which the cited graph-pair orbit theorem does not imply.
residual_risks: Unindexed specialized Heawood graph-braid representation computations could overlap; the actual source literature comparison was bounded.
The 42 disjoint pairs and their automorphism transitivity are prior and must not be advertised as novel alone.

value.rationale: Scientific value PASS: the Heawood graph is a canonical Fano-plane incidence graph with a highly transitive group and smallest cycles of length six. The sharp integral shortest-cycle torus basis, nontrivial H1 2-torsion and full H2 character provide specific geometric, arithmetic and symmetry data that cannot be read from disjoint-cycle counts alone; the finite instance benchmarks equivariant graph braid methods.
residual_risks: The result is exact for one distinguished graph, not a classification of all nonplanar graph braid groups; no unwarranted general consequence asserted.

final_claim: For Heawood H, UConf_2(|H|) has integral H0=Z, H1=Z^8⊕Z/2, H2=Z^14. Its 42 disjoint hexagon-pair torus classes contain a unimodular 14-element integral basis, and the graph automorphism group of order336 acts on H2 with the eight-type rational character (1,14),(21,−2),(56,−1),(42,2),(48,0),(28,−2),(56,1),(84,0); the invariant space is zero.
